digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: gates, observability, migrations, and attestation recovery
propositions: Bug provenance must be captured at creation and trend-queryable without new required user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must block: raw git writes bypassing store, unread config fields, wall-clock asserts in tests, unchecked AC checkboxes at close, dead SHA/run-id/date citations in code comments, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking plan-review attestation.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge, canary workflow, probe harness, vote normalizer) must be migrated from shell to Python.
Canary and automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup pattern with documented bug-creation contract.

Pre-330c attestations silently skipped signing when checkpoint-normalization landed without grandfathering; compute_validity must grandfather legacy attestations matching non-normalized recomputation hash.

Skill discipline upgrades (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, test-design standard) must encode ticket writebacks, invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, contention triggers, and gate-finding oracle upgrades.
